buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses *BIDDER MUST SUBMIT THE SEAL & SIGEND TH E TENDER DOCUMENTS. *BIDDER MUST SUBMIT THE RELEVENT DOCUME NTS AS PER QR AND ITB ATTACHED IN TENDER DOCUMENTS. Qualifying Requirements: 1.

QR1. The bidder should have “Supplied, Installed/got Installed” High Mast Lighting S ystem of height 30 meters or above. QR2. The bidder should have executed the work of supply and/or Installation and/or commissioning of Street Lighting System and/or Solar High Masts Lighting System a nd/or High Mast Lighting System and/or Tower Lighting System and/or Solar Street Li ghting System in India during the financial years from FY 2019–20 to FY 2025–26 (bot h inclusive) in any of the following manner: a) Single Order with executed value not less than INR 132.00 Lakhs OR b) Two (2) Orders with executed value not less than INR 83.00 Lakhs each OR c) Three (3) Orders with executed value not less than INR 66.00 Lakhs each Note: - Reference work executed by the bidder as a sub-contractor may also be considered , provided the certificate issued by main contractor is duly certified by the Principal E mployer specifying the scope of work executed by the bidder. - The word “executed” means the bidder should have completed the work equivalent t o the amount as specified in QR2, even though the total contract(s) is partially exec uted, not completed or not closed. - In case of contract (s) is /are under execution as on last date of FY 2025-26 , the va lue of work executed till such date will be considered provided the principal employer certifies the same. All the work/purchase order value shall be excluding taxes. QR3. The average annual turnover of the bidder in the preceding 03 (Three) financial years, i.e. financial years FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 shall not be less than INR 164.00 Lakhs. Note: - Other income shall not be considered while computing annual turnover. In case the audited financial results for the last financial year are not available, financ ial results certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant shall be considered. If such certification is also not available, the audited results of the three consecutive financia l years preceding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluation. In such ca ses, a certificate from the CEO/CFO, as per the prescribed format enclosed in the bid ding documents, shall be submitted confirming that the latest financial results are un der audit and the Certificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the financial parameters is not available. QR4. The bidder should have valid - PAN, GST and EPFO registration. Notwithstanding anything stated above, RGPPL reserves the right to assess the capa bilities and capacity of the bidder to perform the contract, should the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of RGPPL. Documents required A. In Support of QR1 & QR2: -

a. Copies of Letter of Award / Work Order/Agreement to be submitted along with Completion Certificate / any other document clearly establishing scope of work , value of executed work and completion period. b. Certificate from Client as described under notes of QR2 shall also be provide d wherever required. B. In Support of QR3: - a. Copies of audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account Statement with U DIN number confirming the turnover for preceding three financial years shall b e submitted. b. Certificate from practicing Chartered Accountant or CEO/CFO as described unde r notes of QR3 shall also be provided wherever required. C. In Support of QR4: - Copy of valid- PAN Card, GST and EPFO Registration Certificate. .
